LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Fiction and Non – Fiction 1.3.1 Fiction: The Novel Novel from Africa and novel f.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Fiction and Non – Fiction 1.3.1 Fiction: The Novel Novel from Africa and novel f.

4. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
